name: weave_get_node_catalog
description: Gets the node types you can add to a Weave workflow graph in your workspace. Call it with no arguments to choose from the full list, then with `nodeTypeIds` for the node types you picked to get the handles and settable keys you need before adding them with weave_build_workflow.

nodeTypeIds.description: Ids from the no-argument list to return in full. Omit to get the list.
